s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of a painful, solitary, submucosal mass in the cheek
salient_findings: Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass with ill-defined borders
Smooth mucosal surface without colour change
key_facts: 30-year-old woman
2-month history of swelling in the right cheek
Severe pain associated with the swelling
Diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
Solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass on the right buccal mucosa
Ill-defined borders of the submucosal mass
Smooth mucosal surface without colour change
Ultrasonography showed a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mobile, submucosal mass with smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Ectopic lymph node
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary, mobile mass in the cheek with ill-defined borders

shortlist.label: Angioleiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Painful, submucosal mass in the cheek

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Submucosal mass with smooth mucosal surface

shortlist.label: Neurilemmoma
shortlist.why_kept: Solitary, submucosal mass in the cheek

raw.rationale: The presence of a solitary, mobile, submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface, along with ultrasonography showing a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion, is consistent with a lipoma. Lipomas are common, benign tumors composed of fat tissue and can occur in the cheek region.

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: While considered, ectopic lymph nodes are less common in the cheek region and may not typically present as a solitary, mobile mass.

rejected.label: Angioleiomyoma
rejected.why: Angioleiomyomas are rare, benign tumors that can cause pain, but the clinical and radiographic findings do not strongly suggest this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles typically present as a fluctuant, painless mass, which does not match the severe pain associated with the swelling in this case.

rejected.label: Neurilemmoma
rejected.why: Neurilemmomas are benign nerve sheath tumors that can occur in the head and neck region, but the clinical and radiographic findings do not specifically suggest this diagnosis.
